name: scout-workspace
description: Scout proof of concept workspace (Phases 1-3: plumbing, catalog discovery, personal-context service).

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:agent-contract: vitest run --root packages/scout-core src/agents src/capabilities && vitest run --root packages/scout-mcp && vitest run --root scripts agent-check
scripts.test:pivot: npm run build && npm run test:agent-contract && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:swift: cd native/Scout && swift build && swift test
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
